paragraphs: Glenstal Abbey School is a famous boarding school in Co Limerick. It will close in August 2028.
The school told parents and staff the news last Friday. More than 200 students, aged 12 to 18, go there.
Fewer families want boarding schools now. It also costs a lot of money to run a small boarding school. Experts studied the school and said it could not continue.
Students will finish this school year as normal. Some students will be able to stay until 2028 to finish their courses. Lessons will go on as usual until June 2027.
The monks at Glenstal Abbey said it was a very hard decision.

paragraphs: Glenstal Abbey School in Co Limerick, one of the best-known boarding schools in Ireland, will close in August 2028. Parents and staff heard the news last Friday.

The school's trustees said that demand for boarding education has fallen, and that running a small boarding school is very expensive. An external study of the school found that it was not sustainable in the long term. They said other boarding schools in Ireland and abroad have similar problems.

More than 200 students aged 12 to 18 go to the school. Day pupils pay just under €15,000 a year, and boarders pay up to €24,000. Classes will continue as normal until June 2027. After that, current second-year and fifth-year students will be allowed to stay to finish their Junior and Senior Cycle.

The school is run beside a community of monks. The monks said it was a very difficult decision that they wished they never had to make. School leaders say their main job now is to support students and families.

家長和教職員上週五得知了這個消息。
學校的董事表示，寄宿教育的需求已經下降，而且經營一所小型寄宿學校非常昂貴。
一項外部研究發現，這所學校長期來看無法永續經營。
他們說，愛爾蘭和海外的其他寄宿學校也有類似的問題。
有 200 多名 12 到 18 歲的學生在這所學校就讀。

修士們說，這是一個非常困難、他們希望永遠不必做的決定。
學校領導人表示，他們現在的主要工作是支持學生和家庭。

paragraphs: Glenstal Abbey School in Co Limerick, one of Ireland's best-known boarding schools, is to close in August 2028, its trustees have announced.

Parents and staff were told on Friday that the school would wind down its operations. The trustees blamed a lack of demand for boarding education and the high cost of running a small boarding school, adding that a detailed external assessment had found it would not be sustainable. Boarding schools in Ireland and abroad face similar pressures, they said.

The school has more than 200 pupils aged 12 to 18. Fees are just under €15,000 a year for day pupils and between €21,500 and €24,000 for boarders. Teaching will continue as normal until June 2027, and current second- and fifth-year students will then be allowed to complete their Junior and Senior Cycle.

The monastic community, which runs the school alongside the abbey, described the closure as a very difficult decision. School leaders said their priority was to support students and maintain stability.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭最知名的寄宿學校之一、位於利默里克郡的格倫斯塔爾修道院學校將於 2028 年 8 月關閉，學校董事已宣布此事。
家長和教職員於週五得知學校將逐步結束營運。
董事們將原因歸咎於寄宿教育需求不足，以及經營小型寄宿學校的高昂成本，並補充說一項詳細的外部評估發現學校無法永續經營。
他們說，愛爾蘭和海外的寄宿學校都面臨類似的壓力。
這所學校有 200 多名 12 到 18 歲的學生。
通勤生的學費每年將近 15,000 歐元，住宿生則介於 21,500 到 24,000 歐元之間。
教學將照常進行到 2027 年 6 月，之後目前二年級和五年級的學生可以完成初中和高中階段的學業。
與修道院一同經營學校的修道團體表示，關校是一個非常困難的決定。
學校領導人表示，他們的首要任務是支持學生並維持穩定。

paragraphs: Glenstal Abbey School, one of the country's most storied boarding schools, is to shut its doors in August 2028, bringing a long chapter in the educational life of Co Limerick to a close.

Parents and staff were informed on Friday that the school would be wound down. The trustees attributed the decision to dwindling demand for boarding education and the prohibitive cost of sustaining a small boarding school, noting that a rigorous external review had deemed it unviable. Similar headwinds, they observed, are buffeting boarding schools at home and abroad.

Upwards of 200 pupils aged 12 to 18 currently attend, paying just shy of €15,000 a year as day pupils or up to €24,000 as boarders. Lessons will carry on as usual until June 2027, after which current second- and fifth-year students will be permitted to see out their Junior and Senior Cycle.

The monastic community, which has long propped up the school financially, called it an agonising decision it would rather never have taken. School leaders pledged to prioritise pupils' welfare and preserve stability during the transition.

paragraphs: Glenstal Abbey School, one of Ireland's most prominent boarding schools, is scheduled to close in August 2028, according to an announcement by its trustees.

Parents and staff were informed on Friday that the school would gradually cease operations. The trustees attributed the decision to declining demand for boarding education and the considerable expense of operating a small boarding institution. Furthermore, a comprehensive external assessment had concluded that the school was not financially sustainable. The trustees also noted that comparable pressures are affecting boarding schools both in Ireland and internationally.

The school currently enrols more than 200 students aged between 12 and 18. Annual fees amount to just under €15,000 for day pupils and between €21,500 and €24,000 for boarders. Tuition will continue as normal until June 2027; thereafter, students currently in second and fifth year will be permitted to complete their Junior and Senior Cycle.

The monastic community, which has provided substantial support to the school for many years, described the closure as an exceptionally difficult decision. Nevertheless, school leaders emphasised that their immediate priority is to support students and ensure stability.
